evidence.V1: Top and three-quarter read as a cut stump thanks to the ring cap, but the side silhouette is a cylinder on a flat brim and reads as a hat at 64 px; no individual roots break the outline.
evidence.V2: Big trunk and ring cap are clear, but the root flare is one flat slab with no medium root forms and no small bark detail; hierarchy is partial.
evidence.V3: Straight cylinder plus a thin flat skirt plate; only the skirt outline is irregular, so the form is mostly stiff primitives rather than a confident stylised flare.
evidence.V4: Cut top rim is softly chamfered, but the skirt edge is a hard vertical slab band (close_roots) and the trunk-to-skirt joint is a sharp crease; inconsistent.
evidence.V5: No z-fighting or pinches, but the trunk shows vertical facet banding and a dark smear band where trunk meets skirt (close_roots_studio); minor.
evidence.V6: Bark brown in two values plus cream/tan heartwood rings; disciplined across walnut/redwood/ash colourways (birch rings nearly vanish).
evidence.V7: 440 tris vs medium target 2000; well under.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material and smooth shading match, but the organic root flare is not a fused smooth shell (flat slab with hard rim) and the bullseye rings are more graphic than the kit; minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, white MeshPart colour, origin bottom-centre; gates all pass.
